Fig 4: Real data to operator in five stages:

sources ➔ ingestion/validation ➔ science API ➔ 3D evidence workspace ➔ INCOIS / NDMA operator. Ingestion is decoupled and schema-validated (Pydantic V2) with spatial bounding-box clipping and offline fallback fixtures, guaranteeing sub-second hazard delivery without external telemetry bottlenecks.
